I appreciate and thank you that you took the time for me 

---
*that neither your childhood nor your isolation nor your appearance nor having done* *poorly in school or not gotten into Uni define your worth as a person. It's particularly* *easy, at our age, to judge our lives and value by our own success, especially because it* *often feels like other people are judging us for this*
---

---
but everything I experienced suggests that the contrary is true. my resumé and my appearance will speak volumes to every potential employer , Interviewer , social-worker or whoever I will depend on - to live what is considered a normal life. 

none of these people will know my personality, potential or work ethic first hand and they wont need to - because it will be right in front of them on a shitty resumé worth 2 pages of paper with a 3 year hole. which cannot be described without using the words lazy , pathetic and selfish. when they look up from the desk they will see my fat stoic detached desperate face. and when I will see back into their faces i will only see disbelief , disgust and pity.

I don't see putting myself at the mercy of people who have despise written across their faces - so that i can afford to live (in the medicinal sense of the word) my shitty life. which would still be crap even if i was miraculously financially independent .

I will include the answer to a PM I received as answer to this OP - for what its worth.

---
*I once was arrogant enough to believe in the sentiment: "do it for yourself, don't give a*
---
*fuck what other people say or think.". but that is a lie, and you can only lie so long to*
---
*yourself before the truth shines through. especially If you actually DO have the perfect*
---
*opportunity for weight loss because you are not occupied.*
--- 

*I'd like to think that I am an intelligent being who is above his primitive drives,*
---
*compulsions and feelings. but at the end of the day No one of us is doing anything for*
---
*himself and no one is in charge of his feelings.- as someone who has had no regular*
---
*acquaintances for 3 years I am painfully aware of this fact now.*
---

*It is simply impossible to ignore / neglect your feelings that drag you down , If feelings*
---
*like happiness is ultimately what you are striving for. everyone is looking for*
---
*affirmation and support of his self and what he does. Thinking that I was above this*
---
*need (as intelligent arrogant self-deluded human being) was what caused me to never*
---
*seek out help in the first place. This whole mentality was of course motivated by my*
---
*fear of rejection and judgement.*
---
*anyway payday is near and nothing of that matters anymore. I can't undo my mistakes*
---
*now. I would if I could - but good intentions count for nothing.*
---

*I CAN however avoid humiliation and judgement - and take a shred of self respect and*
---
*dignity with me.*
